name: Wait efficiently for PR checks in the In PR Stage
description:
Factory review recommendation 11 of 20.

## Context

In PR workers repeatedly inspect check and merge state while CI is still running.

## Acceptance criteria

- Use gh pr checks --watch or defer launching In PR work until required checks finish.
- Resume merge/review processing when checks settle and route failed checks to the repair workflow.
- Document timeout, cancellation and pending-check handling without repeated model polling.

Recheck the reviewed behavior against the current implementation and configuration before making changes. Update the relevant documentation, skill guidance and repository configuration together where applicable.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: PLAN ACCEPTED with corrections. Own standalone Waiting for pull request checks section and In PR step 2 proposal only; ROW-47 owns review/approval steps 3-4 and ROW-48 owns failure/return step 5. Independent review may run while checks pending; it must not wait to start solely because checks are pending. Supervisor owns native event watch; workers return exact head and pending state and end their turn. Fallback one bounded background gh pr checks --watch, never model-turn polling. Naming gh in the GitHub-specific fallback is fine; T3-specific tools remain repository policy proposal. Do not treat no checks registered as a failed check: distinguish absent registration, pending/timeout, actual failed conclusion and unreadable PR; absence/timeout returns waiting/question, not repair or failure. Use all checks, not --required. No screenshots/ADR required for text-only guidance. Proposal outside .rowbly, no Data Root edits. Four checks required.
